As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
And when he was going out of the Temple, one of his disciples said to him, Master, see, what stones and what buildings!
耶穌從殿裡出來的時候，有一個門徒對他說：「夫子，請看，這是何等的石頭！何等的殿宇！」
“Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
And Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? there is not one stone here resting on another which will not be overturned.
耶穌對他說：「你看見這大殿宇嗎？將來在這裡沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」
While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives opposite the Temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew said to him privately,
耶穌在橄欖山上對聖殿而坐，彼得、雅各、約翰，和安得烈暗暗地問他說：
“Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
Say when these things will be, and what will be the sign when these things are all about to be done.
「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事呢？這一切事將成的時候有甚麼預兆呢？」
Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
And Jesus said to them, Take care that you are not tricked by anyone.
耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
People will come in my name, saying, I am he; and a number will be turned from the true way.
將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是基督』，並且要迷惑許多人。
When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
And when you have news of wars and talk of wars, do not be troubled; these things have to be, but it is still not the end.
你們聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，不要驚慌。這些事是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
Nation will go to war with nation, and kingdom with kingdom: there will be earth-shocks in different places; there will be times when there is no food; these things are the first of the troubles.
民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有地震、饑荒。這都是災難（災難：原文是生產之難）的起頭。
So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
But take care: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins; and in Synagogues you will be whipped; and you will be taken before rulers and kings because of me, for a sign to them.
但你們要謹慎；因為人要把你們交給公會，並且你們在會堂裡要受鞭打，又為我的緣故站在諸侯與君王面前，對他們作見證。
And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
And the good news has first to be given to all the nations.
然而，福音必須先傳給萬民。
But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
And when you are taken and given up to be judged, do not be troubled about what to say: but whatever is given to you in that hour, say: because it is not you who say it, but the Holy Spirit.
人把你們拉去交官的時候，不要預先思慮說甚麼；到那時候，賜給你們甚麼話，你們就說甚麼；因為說話的不是你們，乃是聖靈。
Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child; and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.
弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要起來與父母為敵，害死他們；
You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
And you will be hated by all men, because of my name; but he who goes through to the end will have salvation.
並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」
So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
But when you see the unclean thing which makes destruction, in the place where it has no right to be (let this be clear to the reader), then let those who are in Judaea go quickly to the mountains:
「你們看見那行毀壞可憎的，站在不當站的地方（讀這經的人須要會意）。那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
And let him who is on the house-top not go down, or go in, to take anything out of his house:
在房上的，不要下來，也不要進去拿家裡的東西；
And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
And let not him who is in the field go back to take his coat.
在田裡的，也不要回去取衣裳。
How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
And it will be hard for women who are with child and for her who has a baby at the breast in those days.
當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！
Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
And say a prayer that it may not be in the winter.
你們應當祈求，叫這些事不在冬天臨到。
For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
For in those days there will be sorrow, such as there has not been from the time when God made the world till now, and will not ever be again.
因為在那些日子必有災難，自從神創造萬物直到如今，並沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
And if the Lord had not made the time short, no flesh would have been kept from destruction; but because of the saints he has made the time short.
若不是主減少那日子，凡有血氣的，總沒有一個得救的；只是為主的選民，他將那日子減少了。
At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
And then if any man says to you, See, here is Christ; or, See, there; have no faith in it:
那時若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在這裡』，或說：『基督在那裡』，你們不要信！
For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
Because there will be false Christs and false prophets, and they will give signs and wonders in the hope of turning even the saints from the true way.
因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯神蹟奇事，倘若能行，就把選民迷惑了。
So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
But take care; see, I have made all things clear to you before the time.
你們要謹慎。看哪，凡事我都預先告訴你們了。」
But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
But in those days, after that time of trouble, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light,
「在那些日子，那災難以後，日頭要變黑了，月亮也不放光，
the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
And the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers which are in the heavens will be moved.
眾星要從天上墜落，天勢都要震動。
At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
And then they will see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
那時，他們（馬太二十四章三十節是地上的萬族）要看見人子有大能力、大榮耀，駕雲降臨。
And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
And then he will send out the angels, and will get together his saints from the four winds, from the farthest part of the earth to the farthest part of heaven.
他要差遣天使，把他的選民，從四方（方：原文是風），從地極直到天邊，都招聚了來。」
Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
Take an example from the fig-tree: when its branches become soft and put out their leaves, you see that the summer is near;
「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
Even so, when you see these things taking place, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.
這樣，你們幾時看見這些事成就，也該知道人子（人子：或譯神的國）近了，正在門口了。
Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
Truly, I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.
我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.
天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」
No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
But of that day or that hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the Son, but the Father.
「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。
Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
Take care, keep watch with prayer: for you are not certain when the time will be.
你們要謹慎，警醒祈禱，因為你們不曉得那日期幾時來到。
It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
It is as when a man who is in another country for a time, having gone away from his house, and given authority to his servants and to everyone his work, gives the porter an order to keep watch.
這事正如一個人離開本家，寄居外邦，把權柄交給僕人，分派各人當做的工，又吩咐看門的警醒。
Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
So you are to keep watch: because you are not certain when the master of the house is coming, in the evening, or in the middle of the night, or at the cock's cry, or in the morning;
所以，你們要警醒；因為你們不知道家主甚麼時候來，或晚上，或半夜，或雞叫，或早晨；
Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
For fear that, coming suddenly, he sees you sleeping.
恐怕他忽然來到，看見你們睡著了。
And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
And what I say to you, I say to all, Keep watch.
我對你們所說的話，也是對眾人說：要警醒！」
